title: &aHere Be Dragons
subtitle: Ice and Fire's dragons and myths, and the dragons of Berk you can bond with.

quests.title: The Bestiary
quests.subtitle: Ice and Fire
desc: &eIce and Fire&r fills the world with myths: fire, ice and lightning dragons, hippogryphs, cyclopes, gorgons, sirens, trolls, sea serpents, the Hydra.
Craft the &eBestiary&r (see JEI). Its pages fill in as you find manuscripts, and it explains how to fight, tame or hatch each creature.

quests.title: Scorched Earth
desc: Dragons grow in five &estages&r, from hatchling to ancient. Wild adults live in &eroosts&r on the surface (burnt or frozen land, piles of gold) or in deep caves full of treasure.
Find a fire dragon roost and look, from a distance. If the dragon is asleep, leave it that way for now.

quests.title: Dragonslayer
desc: Slay a dragon. Never alone: one player draws its breath while the others shoot. Fire resistance potions help a lot against fire dragons.
Dragons are flying bosses. Fight in the open where you can see them coming, and bring lots of arrows.

quests.title: Bone, Blood and Scale
desc: A dead dragon is a treasure chest: &escales&r for armour, &ebones&r for tools and weapons, &eblood&r and a &eheart&r.
Make a dragonbone tool. Then bathe a dragonbone sword in dragon blood for a Flamed, Iced or Lightning blade.

quests.title: The Dragonforge
desc: A &eDragonforge&r is a 3x3x3 shell of Dragonforge Bricks with a core in the centre and an aperture in the wall. A dragon's breath into the aperture is what heats it.
Use your own tamed dragon (or a captured one). Build the core.

quests.title: Dragonsteel
desc: Put iron and dragon blood into a burning Dragonforge and it makes &eDragonsteel&r: the best armour and weapons Ice and Fire offers.
Fire, ice and lightning dragonsteel each burn, freeze or shock what you hit.

quests.title: A Dragon of Your Own
desc: Roosts and caves often hold &edragon eggs&r. Take one while the parent is away (or dead).
Fire eggs hatch in fire, ice eggs in water, lightning eggs under a stormy sky. The Bestiary has the details.

quests.title: Raising a Dragon
desc: Feed your hatchling meat and it grows, stage by stage, over many days. Once it's big enough you can ride it.
The &eDragon Command Staff&r tells it to sit, follow or wander. A &eDragon Horn&r carries it in your pocket.

quests.title: Armour for a Dragon
desc: Your dragon can wear armour too: head, neck, body and tail pieces in iron, gold, diamond, netherite, silver or dragonsteel.
Armour it before you take it into a boss fight.

quests.title: Wings of the Griffon
desc: &eHippogryphs&r (half eagle, half horse) live in the hills and mountains. Tame one and you have a flying mount long before you have a dragon.
Lightwardens: the white hippogryph is your path's steed.

quests.title: Troll Hunt
desc: &eTrolls&r (forest, frost and mountain) live underground and turn to stone in sunlight. Lure one out at dawn, or fight it in its cave.
Their leather makes troll armour; their weapons are tree trunks and stone columns.

quests.title: The One-Eyed Giant
desc: A &eCyclops&r guards its sheep in a cave by the hills. It grabs players and eats them. Don't get grabbed.
Keep your distance and hit it from range.

quests.title: Don't Look
desc: The &eGorgon&r waits in a temple by the sea. Meet her gaze and you turn to stone. Fight with your eyes turned away from her.
Her head, once taken, turns others to stone instead.

quests.title: The Sea Serpent
desc: Far out at sea, &eSea Serpents&r hunt in the deep ocean. Their scales make Tide Guardian armour, the best for underwater fighting.
The &eHydra&r in its swamp cave is a myth of its own: the Wildheart's trial.

quests.title: The Book of Dragons
quests.subtitle: Book of Dragons
desc: Other dragons fly here too: Gronckles, Deadly Nadders, Monstrous Nightmares, Skrills, Whispering Deaths, and the Night Fury. These ones can be &ebefriended&r.
Find a &eHooligan&r (a travelling Viking) and trade with them for the &eBook of Dragons&r. It records what you learn about each species.

quests.title: Find a Roost
desc: Book of Dragons species live in &eroosts&r: barren, cave, cliff, glade and wetland. Roost maps point the way to them.
Find a roost and step inside. Quietly.

quests.title: Earning Trust
desc: Bonding starts slowly. Watch a wild dragon: it will show you what it wants. Give a wild dragon what it asks for.
Patience, not swords. Write what you learn in the Book of Dragons.

quests.title: Hold On Tight
desc: Once it trusts you, climb on. A wild dragon bucks: hold on until it calms down, and it's yours.
Bind it to a &eRattlestaff&r or &eDragon Whistle&r to call and command it.

quests.title: A True Bond
desc: Keep flying with your dragon, feeding it and fighting beside it, and the two of you bond.
A bonded dragon is a partner, not a pet. Wildhearts know the difference.

quests.title: The Unholy Offspring of Lightning and Death
desc: The &eNight Fury&r is the rarest and fastest of them all. Few have seen one; fewer have tamed one.
Optional, and a long hunt.
